_what_this_is: the complete enumeration of the 14 failures that aborted C1 attempt 3R at the pod CPU test gate. The pod reported 3 names: autoinit_preflight_setup.sh tails 4 lines of /workspace/pytest.log and the file dies with the pod. This was recovered at $0 by running the same suite with HOME pointed at an empty directory, which is the condition a fresh pod is actually in.

reproduction.command: HOME=<empty dir> PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/ -q -p no:randomly --ignore=tests/data/test_recovery_corpus_pipeline.py --ignore=tests/pod/test_phase_a_stages1_5_execute.py
reproduction.reconciliation: 13 = the pod's 14 minus the two repository-state failures already fixed, plus one gate test that needs network the empty HOME denies -- an artifact of the sweep, not a pod failure

the_fourteen.error: FileNotFoundError: <repo>@<rev> is not in the local hub cache at <HOME>/.cache/huggingface/hub/...
the_fourteen.cause: scripts/data/battery_render.py:33 sets HUB = Path.home()/'.cache/huggingface/hub' and reads it DIRECTLY, ignoring HF_HOME -- which pod setup sets to /workspace/hf. The dev box holds all seven dataset snapshots from earlier work; a fresh pod holds none, and warming HF_HOME would not help because the path is not consulted.

scripts/autoinit/publish_selected_leaves.py:110 and retire_relay_copies.py:59 read ~/.cache/huggingface/token. Pod setup writes the token to $HF_HOME/token instead, so the path these read is empty on every pod.
the_fourteen.note: this is why the repair is a CLASS and not one file. Fixing only the battery tests would have left these five to fail the same gate on the next attempt, after a 'fixed' report.

the_fourteen.cause: logs/autoinit_c1_attempt3r{,_grant.json} were created during the repricing and never classified in CATALOG.md

current_state.json recorded an authorization as live, which it truthfully was at launch time. Creating the pod consumed it, so the snapshot now records that and the assertion holds. The underlying tension -- this test asserts nothing is authorized, while the pod's gate runs DURING a session -- is real and unresolved.
the_fourteen.status: FIXED at 5118755; the structural tension is not

why_it_was_never_seen: no C1 attempt had reached TESTS_OK before: attempt 1 died at the bundle fetch, attempt 2 at ROPE_OK, attempt 3 never created a pod.
tooling_gap: scripts/pod/simulate_pod_env.sh exists to answer 'would this suite pass on a pod?' and hides gitignored REPO artifacts the bundle cannot carry. It says nothing about $HOME. Running it before this launch would not have caught any of the twelve environment failures.
diagnostic_gap: autoinit_preflight_setup.sh runs `tail -4 /workspace/pytest.log` then `exit 1`. One `grep '^FAILED\|^ERROR'` before exiting would have brought all fourteen home for free.
